name: Soil nematodes
description: Soil nematodes of the hummock sands - over 5,200 extracted, dominated by bacterial-feeders (84.8% of biomass: Acrobeles, Cephalobus, Cervidellus and kin) with fungal-feeders (Aphelenchoides and kin, 14.7%) and a sprinkle of omnivores. They run on the deposited wind-blown organics, not the fog grass, and the source read the bacterial-feeders as secondary decomposers while the fungal-feeders' depleted nitrogen echoes lichen-feeders elsewhere. Functional group pooling the source's genus-level nematode assemblage by feeding type.
